item.title: mRgendrAgama quote
item.description: (Source: https://threader.app/thread/1368614102864556034) My favorite śloka in the Mṛgendrāgama, revealed by Devendra to Bharadvāja-Ṛṣi. 🙏🏾 शैवे सिद्धे भाति मूर्ध्नीतरेषां मुक्तस् सृष्टौ पुंवरोऽभ्येति नाधः । विश्वान् अर्थान् स्वेन विष्टभ्य धाम्ना सर्वेशानान् ईरितस् सर्वदास्ते ॥ २९ ॥ “In the perfection [obtained] in the Śaiva [path], [He] shines above all others. The liberated one, at [the start of the next] creation, is a supreme person; he falls down not. Being never impelled by the [supreme] lord of all (i.
